sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Flow cytometry confirmed surface display of tagged CDH16 on CHO stable transfectants (CHO/CDH16 positive, parental CHO-K1 negative); no cadherin functional assay reported.
sites.rationale: The signal peptide of CDH16 spans residues 1-18 (per topology landmarks); the mature N-terminus begins at residue 19 (K). Placing the MAP16 tag after residue 18 is the only junction consistent with 'N-terminal tag on signal-sequence-deleted CDH16.' Python verification confirms residue 18 = P and residue 19 = K. The tag (16 aa) falls within the 13-23 aa target range, and the extracellular span (19-784, 766 residues) places the tag far from the TM boundary. Full-length CDH16 with signal-sequence deleted and MAP16 tag (PGTGDGMVPPGIEDKI) appended at the N-terminus, expressed in CHO cells via pCAG-Ble vector; stable transfectants generated and sorted by anti-MAP16 mAb (clone PMab-1) by flow cytometry.

sources.claim: The signal sequence-deleted CDH16 cDNAs with an N-terminal MAP16 tag (PGTGDGMVPPGIEDKI) was subcloned into the pCAG-Ble vector (FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical Corporation, Osaka, Japan).
The signal sequence-deleted CDH16 cDNAs with an N-terminal PA16-tag (GLEGGVAMPGAEDDVV) were subcloned into the pCAG-Ble vector.

literature_notes: L3 and L4 provide flow-cytometry validation of surface display for both tagged constructs (MAP16 and PA16) but report no functional assay (e.g., cadherin-mediated cell-cell adhesion), so validation_level is surface_only for both sites. The ledger contains no evidence for any internal loop insertion or C-terminal tag in CDH16. L4 is used as corroborating evidence for L1/L2 but is not the primary supporting clip for either site. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions are reported in the ledger.
